title: Next: plans that travel, under an Auth
summary: Order agreed 24 Nov 2026. (1) A plan round trip on RTO2: a checked one-step Plan is captured with alchemy_rto_core dev4, rebuilt inert in a second process that has the Plan class installed, admitted (schema, target, sequence, digest, seal), bound and activated under that side's NewShell policy, and its result captured back. Two processes on one box first. (2) The Auth (newshell.auth): signing in the su-locked account, delegates per host, RTO_AUTH_LOCKED / RTO_AUTH_EXPIRED / RTO_NO_DELEGATE in admit. (3) newshell dev7 objects: Archive (browsable, not unzip), file selections, the source editor (oorexx_source_editor dev9) as shell objects, a Lock object whose protected remove passes only when the lock is stale (ChatGPT's review: the dev4 recovery removed build.lock without proof), the firewall read as nft -j JSON. Then: xtpd STATUS, MU start beyond xtpd, orphan cleanup for a died step, an autopilot budget per chain.
